**STATUS: STOP — needs B's ruling on DC-KINDS.** That check is in `perf/lib/report.test.ts`, which this task doesn't let me edit. The full report is `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-363.md`, with evidence under `a-round-363/`.

**Why it stopped:** the perf-lib check (A-PERF-LIB) ran **39/40**. The test `DC-KINDS` requires that every `commits-per-move` row in the budgets file match the pattern `interact.drag.(range|fade|trim|move)…`. The task requires two new `interact.drag.background-range.stopped.commits-per-move` rows (1× and 6×), which that pattern doesn't cover. Both rows are `wallclock`, so what the test is meant to protect still holds; only its pattern doesn't know the new drag. I didn't edit the test and didn't rename the metric to get around it.

**Options for B:**
- **(a)** Allow `report.test.ts` to change: add `background-range` to the pattern and change the expected count from 16 to 18. This keeps the check meaningful, and it is the smallest re-dispatch: that one edit, docs 234 and 168, then perf-lib and the code-reviewer again. No `app/` change and no new perf run are needed.
- **(b)** Give the two budget rows a different metric name. That works around the check rather than fixing it.
- **(c)** Drop the two rows. The budgets file then has 262 rows.

**What passed:**
- **A-CLAIMS pre:** matches the planning output (`claims-pre.txt`).
- **Typecheck and lint:** both exit 0, with 205 lint warnings (the same as HEAD). Biome on `render-budget.test.tsx` alone is clean.
- **A-TESTS:** `render-budget.test.tsx` passes 13/13, including RB-MEMO1–3. The slowest test takes 1.6 s, well under half the 5 s timeout.
- **A-MUTANT:** each of MU-P, MU-W and MU-R fails only its own RB-MEMO row (12/13 each). I ran them on a scratch copy; the store source is unchanged.
- **A-PERF:** I ran it alone on the production build. It took 483 s and every pass finished with no problems.
  - 264 rows, and all 95 asserted rows pass.
  - Every one of the 181 existing deterministic rows equals round 362's value, so nothing before or after the new step changed.
  - The new lane-background drag's liveness row is 1 at both CPU rates.
- **New values (1× / 6×):**
  - `commits-per-move`: 0.983 / 0.983
  - `move-components-max`: 37 / 37
  - `release-commits`: 1 / 1
  - `move-to-paint-p95`: 2.6 / 16.1 ms
  - `move-components-per-move`: 7.383 / 7.383

  These values stay valid under option (a) or (b).

**Not done:**
- Docs 234 and 168. Their status line would read "Completed (C round 363 PASS)", which isn't true on a STOP.
- The code-reviewer findings. The reviewer found nothing Medium or higher: 3 Lows, 3 Infos and no architecture concern. I recorded them for B but didn't apply them, because editing now would also make the perf run out of date.

**Tree:** 3 modified files, consistent with each other: the B sketch applied unchanged, the perf spec, and the budgets file (264 rows, 95 asserted). Nothing is committed. Two claims differ from what the finished round expects only because the docs aren't written: K2 shows 3 changed files instead of 5, and K14 and K16 are unchanged. PERF-10 is not closed.
